set_aside: v. 8 (catalogued as "whole psalm"), Ma'avar Yabbok, Siftei Tzedek: quotes Psalm 86:15, not this psalm.
v. 8, Ma'avar Yabbok, Minchat Aharon (two rows): quotes Exodus 34:6 and Psalm 86:15, not this psalm.
v. 8, Tashlich (Sefard Rosh Hashanah machzor): "ה' ארך אפים ורב חסד" is Numbers 14:18 (continues "ונקה לא ינקה פוקד עון אבות").
v. 8, Ma'avar Yabbok, Author's Introduction: "חנון ורחום הוא ... ארך אפים ורב חסד" follows the Joel 2:13 / Jonah 4:2 order, not this psalm.
v. 2, Polish selichot, fourth day of the Ten Days: "וְאַל תִּשְׁכַּח" is a common idiom in a selicha by Eliyah b. Shemaya, not this psalm.
v. 4, El Adon (Shabbat and High Holiday morning, all rites): "חֶסֶד וְרַחֲמִים מָלֵא כְבוֹדוֹ" is a stock pairing, not this psalm.
v. 4, Lithuanian selichot, Erev Rosh Hashanah: "וּמָצָא חֶסֶד וְרַחֲמִים" (of Jacob) is an idiom, not this psalm.
v. 4, Ma'avar Yabbok, Imrei Noam: "חסד ורחמים" in a kabbalistic discourse is an idiom, not this psalm.

v. 19, Harachaman of Birkat HaMazon for a Brit Milah (Siddur Sefard; Chabad): "עַד הוּכַן כִּסְאוֹ כַּשֶּׁמֶשׁ וְיָהֲלוֹם" speaks of the throne of Elijah ("like the sun", cf. Ps 89:37). It is a common idiom of an established throne, not this psalm.
